task.prompt:
Write a PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL stored procedure named sp.

The exact procedure signature is:
sp(para_Rating integer, para_Address text, para_ResID integer, para_StuID integer, para_LName text)

The procedure must return no result set.

Use the attached SQL core file core.sql as the SQL core. Replace the placeholders in that file as follows:
<arg1> -> para_Rating
<arg2> -> para_Address
<arg4> -> para_StuID
<arg5> -> para_LName

Replace every {CONSTANT_NAME} placeholder in the attached SQL core with the corresponding value from the attached constants file constants.md.

Write the procedure in PL/pgSQL, named sp, returning no result set. The procedure must have no explicit exception handling. If any statement raises an error, the procedure stops and the error is raised to the caller.

Return the complete stored procedure, and nothing else.

materials.text: IF <arg1> < <arg3> THEN UPDATE "Restaurant" SET "Address" = {RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE1_A}; DELETE FROM "Restaurant" WHERE "Rating" = {RESTAURANT_DELETE_RATING_PHASE1_FIRST}; UPDATE "Restaurant" SET "Address" = {RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE1_B}; DELETE FROM "Restaurant" WHERE "Rating" = {RESTAURANT_DELETE_RATING_PHASE1_SECOND}; UPDATE "Restaurant" SET "Address" = {RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE1_C}; DELETE FROM "Restaurant" WHERE "Rating" = {RESTAURANT_DELETE_RATING_PHASE1_THIRD}; UPDATE "Student" SET "LName" = {STUDENT_LNAME_PHASE1_A}; DELETE FROM "Student" WHERE "StuID" = {STUDENT_DELETE_STUID_PHASE1_FIRST}; UPDATE "Student" SET "LName" = {STUDENT_LNAME_PHASE1_B}; DELETE FROM "Student" WHERE "StuID" = {STUDENT_DELETE_STUID_PHASE1_SECOND}; UPDATE "Student" SET "LName" = {STUDENT_LNAME_PHASE1_C}; DELETE FROM "Student" WHERE "StuID" = {STUDENT_DELETE_STUID_PHASE1_THIRD}; UPDATE "Restaurant" SET "Address" = <arg2>; DELETE FROM "Restaurant" WHERE "Rating" = <arg1>; UPDATE "Student" SET "LName" = <arg5>; DELETE FROM "Student" WHERE "StuID" = <arg4>; UPDATE "Restaurant" SET "Address" = {RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE2_A}; DELETE FROM "Restaurant" WHERE "Rating" = {RESTAURANT_DELETE_RATING_PHASE2_FIRST}; UPDATE "Restaurant" SET "Address" = {RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE2_B}; DELETE FROM "Restaurant" WHERE "Rating" = {RESTAURANT_DELETE_RATING_PHASE2_SECOND}; UPDATE "Student" SET "LName" = {STUDENT_LNAME_PHASE2_A}; DELETE FROM "Student" WHERE "StuID" = {STUDENT_DELETE_STUID_PHASE2_FIRST}; UPDATE "Student" SET "LName" = {STUDENT_LNAME_PHASE2_B}; DELETE FROM "Student" WHERE "StuID" = {STUDENT_DELETE_STUID_PHASE2_SECOND}; UPDATE "Restaurant" SET "Address" = {RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE2_C}; DELETE FROM "Restaurant" WHERE "Rating" = {RESTAURANT_DELETE_RATING_PHASE2_THIRD}; UPDATE "Student" SET "LName" = {STUDENT_LNAME_PHASE2_C}; DELETE FROM "Student" WHERE "StuID" = {STUDENT_DELETE_STUID_PHASE2_THIRD}; UPDATE "Restaurant" SET "Address" = {RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_COMPLETION_MARKER} WHERE "Rating" = {RESTAURANT_COMPLETION_RATING_SENTINEL}; UPDATE "Student" SET "LName" = {STUDENT_LNAME_COMPLETION_MARKER} WHERE "StuID" = {STUDENT_COMPLETION_STUID_SENTINEL}; ELSE UPDATE "Restaurant" SET "Address" = <arg2> WHERE "Rating" = <arg1>; UPDATE "Student" SET "LName" = <arg5> WHERE "StuID" = <arg4>; END IF; DELETE FROM "Visits_Restaurant" WHERE "ResID" IN (SELECT "ResID" FROM "Restaurant" WHERE "Rating" < <arg1>);

# Constants

- `{RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_COMPLETION_MARKER}`: Address value assigned to remaining Restaurant rows with Rating=999 as a completion marker., value = 'complete'
- `{RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE1_A}`: Address value assigned to all Restaurant rows in the first staged update before the Rating=1 delete., value = 'A'
- `{RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE1_B}`: Address value assigned to remaining Restaurant rows in the second staged update before the Rating=2 delete., value = 'B'
- `{RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE1_C}`: Address value assigned to remaining Restaurant rows in the third staged update before the Rating=3 delete., value = 'C'
- `{RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE2_A}`: Address value assigned to remaining Restaurant rows in the first phase2 update before the Rating=101 delete., value = 'phase2_A'
- `{RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE2_B}`: Address value assigned to remaining Restaurant rows in the second phase2 update before the Rating=102 delete., value = 'phase2_B'
- `{RESTAURANT_ADDRESS_PHASE2_C}`: Address value assigned to remaining Restaurant rows in the third phase2 update before the Rating=103 delete., value = 'phase2_C'
- `{RESTAURANT_COMPLETION_RATING_SENTINEL}`: Rating equality value identifying Restaurant rows to receive the completion address., value = 999
- `{RESTAURANT_DELETE_RATING_PHASE1_FIRST}`: Rating equality value used to delete Restaurant rows in the first staged delete., value = 1
- `{RESTAURANT_DELETE_RATING_PHASE1_SECOND}`: Rating equality value used to delete Restaurant rows in the second staged delete., value = 2

- `{STUDENT_LNAME_COMPLETION_MARKER}`: LName value assigned to remaining Student rows with StuID=999 as a completion marker., value = 'complete_log'
- `{STUDENT_LNAME_PHASE1_A}`: LName value assigned to all Student rows in the first staged update before the StuID=1 delete., value = 'log_A'
- `{STUDENT_LNAME_PHASE1_B}`: LName value assigned to remaining Student rows in the second staged update before the StuID=2 delete., value = 'log_B'

Is `{RESTAURANT_DELETE_RATING_PHASE2_THIRD}` for the third or the fourth phase2 delete?
